fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2026-08-02 states that a person promoting a trading group collected Rs. 1,85,000 from the complainant with an assurance of high returns, on 2026-07-29 at roughly 11:10. The online submission was made by Anand Chandran (9000000060). The complaint refers to Murugan Sundaram, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000207. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100043. Chandran Krishnan (9000000031) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Ajith Nathan, using the number 9000000297. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference and a call detail reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Bank transaction reference; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Scheme reportedly promoted through a messaging group.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, morning, call detail, witness, associate, apartment complex, bank reference
